findings.finding: Two DOI identifiers included an 80-hyphen web-output separator.
findings.fix: The current merge removes only that confirmed separator; original scout files and v1 remain preserved. Both cleaned IDs and source query references close exactly in v4.

findings.finding: arXiv DOI, IEEE document, PII, formal-title, truncated-title and Llama mirror identities had split records.
findings.fix: Applied identity mappings preserve raw query IDs, aliases and metadata, and collapse repeated canonical IDs within each query. Current counts recompute to 2599 canonical query occurrences and 1467 candidate records; original raw result-ID occurrences remain 2609.

findings.finding: The testing/security scout searched both topics, but has no direction fields and no one-to-one records for the twelve configured literature-review query families. The other eight directions cover all fifty configured families.
findings.fix: Describe this as digest retrieval across ten topics. Do not claim this evidence reran all configured external review searches. Root states existing review external query audits, references, core content and reviewedAt will remain unchanged.

findings.finding: Candidate records include non-paper pages such as author profiles, event listings and discovery mirrors; some page-title identities are not scholarly IDs.
findings.fix: Use retrieved candidate records, not verified unique papers, for the 1467 total. Final selector must preserve non-paper resource dispositions separately and count papers/read-depth only from actual screening evidence.

findings.finding: OpenAlex requests are bounded: policy two 50-record year-2026 pages without provider total; representation world-model query returned 100 of 1068; assurance returned 50 of 90 and 50 of 664. Other OpenAlex returned counts are 29/29, 93/93, 74/74, 13/13. SSL/429/dependency failures are preserved as limited rather than empty discovery evidence.
findings.fix: Keep those caps and failure states in the final retrieval narrative; no exhaustive-coverage or no-new-papers claims.

findings.finding: The first web bundle is a normalized nine-record inventory, not original provider bytes; its query timestamp is explicitly minute-approximate. Policy initial unsaved two-query probe was rerun into archived individual queries.
findings.fix: Retain rawEvidenceKind and timestampPrecision; raw hashes attest the stored artifacts, not unavailable original provider responses.

findings.finding: Full October monthly pages have month-only headings. The recent map independently provides October 6-12 day headings. Prior October 5 issue captured through October 2. Metadata publication/submission dates and list-announcement dates are distinct.
findings.fix: Use coverage page retrievedAt timestamps as capture evidence and recent heading mapping for known announcement days. A difference from the previous snapshot or an October issue month alone does not establish a new submission or exact announcement date.

findings.finding: Prior metadata checks and release feeds are metadata-only. Release scope is the 28 repositories named in existing report source frontmatter, with no claim about commits or externally hosted data/model updates.
findings.fix: State exactly that 158 arXiv identities had no later updated timestamp and 28 release feeds had zero matching release/asset events. Do not infer that no resource changed anywhere.
